scene_description: Two large white adult swans and four small fluffy gray baby swans (cygnets) swimming together on a calm pond. The two adult swans swim on either side of the cygnets, with a duck visible in the background.

questions.question: What animals do you see in the water?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big white birds swimming in the water.

questions.question: What are the swans doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the swans and what their bodies are doing in the water.

questions.question: Where are the baby swans swimming?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at where the small gray fluffy babies are compared to the two big white swans.

questions.question: How many baby swans do you see?
questions.evidence_hint: Count the small gray fluffy birds swimming in the middle.

questions.question: What might the big swans be doing to keep the babies safe?
questions.sentence_frame: The big swans are staying ___ the babies.
questions.evidence_hint: Look at where the big swans are compared to the little ones — are they close or far away?

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever seen a swan or a duck at a pond?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you went somewhere with water and saw birds.
